title: Frontiers: Spilling the Beans on Political Consumerism: Do Social Media Boycotts and Buycotts Translate to Real Sales Impact?
eligible_reason: Single national event (Goya CEO statement, week 202028 of July 2020). Table 2 is a household-level before/after regression (after + covid_week | user_id week_of_year state_quarter). Table 3 interacts after with the continuous county vote-share difference (per_point_diff) or its terciles. Figures 4 and 7-10 are rolling weekly post coefficients. No unit-specific adoption dates.
design_notes: Code is inside replication.7z (do-files extracted read-only to the scratchpad for screening). Section 3/Table2.do: reghdfe totalgoya_win after covid_week if Week<=202030, a(user_id week_of_year state_quarter) cluster(fips). Section 4/Table3.do: reghdfe totalgoya_win after diff_after covid_week (diff_after = after x per_point_diff, continuous). Table4.do: race x after interactions. Figure4.do: week_2020xx x post dummies. Numerator household-week panel, 2019 to 2020.
n_eligible_specs_note: No staggered binary treatment; the treatment date is common to all households.

specs.treatment_var: diff_after = after x per_point_diff (continuous county vote-share difference)
specs.notes: Excluded: single common event date and continuous treatment intensity.

data_access: proprietary (Numerator panel under NDA); package ships simulated data
data_files: Replication file/replication.7z (249 MB): Section 2/Data/hh_char.dta, main_data_fillin.dta (982 MB), newbuyer_nb.dta, twitter_media.dta; Section 4/Data/300_brands.csv, brand_share_polar_subsample.dta, freq_user_list.dta
data_files_note: Readme.txt: 'we provide simulated data with random 50% draws from the original data and add a normally distributed random noise.' This is noised (fuzzed) data under the protocol.
software_notes: Stata reghdfe, winsor2, coefplot. Hard-coded Linux cluster paths.
priority_note: Not staggered; data are a 50% draw with added noise.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text). Extracted only the .do files from replication.7z with bsdtar into the scratchpad; the data were not extracted.
